subject.why: The envelope is immediately recognisable, puffy and sealed with the requested red wax seal stamped with a footprint.

category.why: The envelope floats in the air with a slight tilt against a sky-blue background with centred radiating light rays and no ground or extra props.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, borders, or characters.

framing.why: The object is centrally placed with generous margins on all sides and a clear silhouette.

colour.why: The sky-blue background is bright and saturated with clear rays, and the warm cream envelope and red wax seal contrast distinctly against it.

detail.why: Shapes are clean and chunky with no noisy micro-textures or extraneous elements.

style.why: The 3D render features soft puffy volumes, smooth satin finishes, a glossy wax seal, and no outlines, matching the reference style.

bg_colour.why: background is blue (87% of the background); planned blue
